biomed.description: Curated PubMed/EuropePMC biomedical research metadata with MeSH terms, clinical relevance scoring, and drug-condition mapping. 149K+ items covering clinical trials, drug interactions, disease pathways.

finance.description: Regulatory classification, filings metadata, market intelligence, entity enrichment across SEC/CFTC/FCA/ESMA

nlp.description: Quality-scored language resources with token-level metadata, validation flags, and training eligibility markers. 398K+ Q&A pairs from StackExchange/Reddit/StackOverflow for fine-tuning.

ai.description: AI papers, cross-referenced GitHub repos, model metadata, benchmarks from HuggingFace, arXiv, and GitHub. 104K+ items with training readiness flags.

vision.description: Image classification, segmentation, and object detection metadata with quality scores and training readiness

knowledge-graph.description: 568K+ entity relationship records with provenance — entities, relations, and knowledge graph triples for RAG and entity linking applications.

full-archive.description: Complete PREDATOR archive — 2.36M items across all 24 domains from 53 curated sources. Comprehensive AI training corpus with provenance and quality scores.
